description: Paralympian, women's para swimming, six Games, strong brand story.

facts.fact: 31 Paralympic medals, 18 of them gold (count as of the 2024 Games).
Born in Bratsk, Russia, and adopted by American parents.
Youngest member of the U.S. team at the 2004 Athens Paralympics, aged 12.
Her story was told in Toyota's 'Upstream' Super Bowl ad (2021).
ESPY Award for Best Female Athlete with a Disability (2007, 2012, 2013).
Gold in the 400m freestyle S8 and 100m butterfly S8 at Paris 2024.
